_note: Vet student practice mode. pet_names: picked at random for each case (a name says nothing about the diagnosis). tests: diagnostic catalog ids -> the case symptoms that test can show, with the finding it reports. A test only reports findings for symptoms the stored case actually has; anything else comes back as no abnormal findings.

exam.limping: Lame on one leg; pain when the limb is handled.
exam.swelling: A firm, warm swelling is present.
exam.lump: A lump is felt under the skin.
exam.bad-breath: Tartar buildup and red gums; bad breath.
exam.itching: Red, irritated skin with scratch marks.
exam.sneezing: Nasal discharge; sneezing in the room.
exam.lethargy: Quiet and dull in the exam room.
exam.weight-loss: Thin body condition compared with last records.

blood-panel.drinking-more: Abnormal kidney or sugar values that fit increased thirst.
blood-panel.urinating-more: Abnormal kidney or sugar values that fit increased urination.
blood-panel.weight-loss: Changes consistent with ongoing weight loss.
blood-panel.lethargy: Abnormal values that could explain low energy.
blood-panel.not-eating: Abnormal values that could explain poor appetite.

t4.weight-loss: Thyroid level is worth reviewing alongside the weight loss.
t4.drinking-more: Thyroid level is worth reviewing alongside the increased thirst.

xrays-abd.vomiting: Abnormal gas or contents in the stomach or intestines.
xrays-abd.ate-something: A possible foreign object in the gut.

xrays-chest.coughing: Changes in the lungs or airways.
xrays-chest.breathing-trouble: Changes in the lungs, airways or around the heart.

xrays-limb.limping: Changes in the bone or joint of the sore leg.
xrays-limb.swelling: Soft-tissue swelling around the bone or joint.
xrays-limb.pain: Bone or joint changes in the painful area.

fecal.diarrhea: Abnormal stool sample; parasites or overgrowth possible.

ear-cytology.ear-scratching: Yeast and/or bacteria in the ear swab.

skin-cytology.itching: Yeast and/or bacteria on the skin.
skin-cytology.hair-loss: Yeast and/or bacteria where the hair is thin.

eye-stain.squinting: The stain picks up a scratch on the eye's surface.
